text:
maya: FYI incident triage just hit a roadblock — SOC needs short-term access to raw auth logs that are inside the SIEM but encrypted with the CMK. Can we define a fastpath for emergency unwrapping and a retention exception?
jordan: What's the exact scope? which tenants/dates? we should capture justification and ticket id before any unwrap.
maya: Tenant: customer-acct-23, window: last 72h, reason: active exfil triage, ticket #INC-4921. Need analyst to pivot within next 2 hours.
sam: +1 to a tight scope. propose: 48h ephemeral view (not full export), KMS unwrap via proxy with one-time ephemeral KEK, audit-log emitted for each unwrap call.
leon: Technically doable — we have a KMS-proxy path. Questions: who signs the unwrap and how do we rotate the ephemeral key? also need to ensure SIEM export pipeline doesn't automatically forward these logs to partners.
maya: Good call. we should block downstream forwarding during the exception window. set a flag on the SIEM view: export_block=true.
jordan: Approvers: sec-lead + oncall + product-security. Template: request, ticket link, minimal scope, start/end times, approver list. Can we automate approval via OPA if ticket label=incident?
sam: OPA could allow but require human second approval for CMK unwrap. automation = pre-checks (ticket age, owner) then send approval ping to sec-lead.
leon: KMS side: create ephemeral wrapping key with TTL=2h, generated by KMS-proxy. unwrap calls audit-record: {caller, ticket, nonce, unwrap_ts}. we'll store the nonce in audit index.
sec-bot: [audit] Detected SIEM unwrapping attempt for customer-acct-23 by maya at 1756784405 — pending approval.
maya: For the analyst workflow: we give a bounded role 'incident-analyst-temp' with session duration 2h and no export permission. They can run queries and mark artifacts for stash but not copy raw blobs out.
jordan: Also require prompt-level redaction for PII fields in any ad-hoc export. if analyst needs raw for legal, escalate to legal + sec lead.
sam: Let's add a small playbook snippet to the ticket template: ```Request: INC-####, tenant, window, justification
Approvers: sec-lead, oncall
Access: incident-analyst-temp, duration 48h view / 2h unwrap TTL
SIEM: export_block=true, snapshot_ttl=7d, audit_index=true```
leon: Implementation notes: will need a short runbook for oncall to trigger KMS-proxy ephemeral KEK and to flip export_block. I can draft a bash helper to call the proxy.
maya: Drafting ticket now and pinging sec-lead. filing as INC-4921 and tagging @jordan @leon.
jordan: sounds good. next step: leon drafts runbook + helper, sam updates ticket template and sec-lead gives final approval. after approval, record all unwrap events in long-term audit index (retention 3 years) but scrub tenant IDs in public logs.
maya: thanks team — will follow up in the ticket with approvals. :thumbsup:
